adventureThreads.title: The Forgotten Radio
adventureThreads.origin: A battered radio appears on the repair table with one station still faintly audible.
adventureThreads.meaning: Follow an object history, meet the people attached to it, and decide what should be preserved.

stages.title: Listen before opening it
stages.description: Trace the fault and ask where the radio came from before replacing anything.

stages.title: Find the voice behind the note
stages.description: A name inside the casing points toward an old resident and an unfinished story.

stages.title: Restore it without erasing its history
stages.description: Make it usable again while keeping the marks that explain where it has been.

history.message: Player discovered The Forgotten Radio. It has no deadline and can be released without punishment.

adventureThreads.title: The New Neighbor Who Knows Nobody
adventureThreads.origin: A new resident keeps circling the square without quite joining anything.
adventureThreads.meaning: Offer connection without trapping, fixing, or making yourself indispensable.

stages.title: Make room without demanding a story
stages.description: Offer a seat and an easy exit. Let silence remain possible.

stages.title: Show choices, not a correct path
stages.description: Share a few places and people they might like, while leaving the choice entirely theirs.

stages.title: Let the connection breathe
stages.description: Meet again only because both of you choose to, not because the game demands a loyalty meter.

adventureThreads.title: A Map of Quiet Places
adventureThreads.origin: Someone wonders whether a city can be mapped by how it feels instead of only by streets.
adventureThreads.meaning: Discover small places where different kinds of people can breathe, think, meet, or be alone.

stages.title: Notice what maps usually ignore
stages.description: Walk without a destination and mark three places by atmosphere rather than function.

stages.title: Compare different kinds of quiet
stages.description: Ask someone else which places let them feel most like themselves.

stages.title: Leave a map that does not command anyone
stages.description: Share suggestions as possibilities, not a ranking or route people must follow.

adventureThreads.title: The Unexpected Teacher
adventureThreads.origin: Someone you barely noticed is quietly excellent at a skill you have always found difficult.
adventureThreads.meaning: Learn through mutual respect without turning a mentor into an authority over your life.
